target_customer: Customer support and IT service teams wanting a tier 1 virtual agent
problem: Support teams spend time on repetitive tier 1 tickets; Percept.AI offered a no code virtual agent on its own language engine with human handoff.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI virtual agents

founders.name: Joe (Zhou) Sha
founders.background_notes: YC page bio says ex Googler and later sold Percept.AI to Atlassian.

founders.name: Deyang (Derek) Zhao
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder/CTO; bio cut off.

founders.name: Shuo Han
founders.background_notes: Listed on YC page; no bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: A proprietary natural language understanding engine for intent and sentiment with human handoff was hard for a seven person team in 2017.

defensibility.rationale: Many chatbot vendors existed and large language models later commoditized NLU; no sourced data moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Helpdesk vendors added bots; Atlassian bought Percept.AI in January 2022 for Jira Service Management.

market_need_then: Support automation and chatbots were a hot area in 2017; specific demand evidence at Percept.AI was not found.

branding.domain_note: Used percept.ai, an AI top level domain, not a .com.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself; search results were swamped by similarly named companies.

outcome_analysis: Percept.AI built a no code virtual agent on its own language understanding engine, raised only an undisclosed seed from investors including Tribe Capital and Y Combinator, and sold to Atlassian on January 27, 2022 for undisclosed terms to be built into Jira Service Management. The scale of the exit and its customer traction are not public, so the quality of the outcome is unknown.
notes: percept.ai returned HTTP 503 so the site was not read. TechCrunch cites Crunchbase for the seed investors with no amount or date; PitchBook and CB Insights snippets put total raised near 150K, unverified and not recorded. No 2017 dated competitor source found (CB Insights lists current rivals Forethought, Kustomer, Ada), so the list is empty. Success factor technical_moat is weakly supported. Founder education not found. CB Insights shows a December 2022 news item that conflicts with the January 2022 date; TechCrunch used.
